# Tax file number declaration

How to complete a tax file number (TFN) declaration so your payer can work out how much tax to withhold from payments.

**Last updated** 28 May 2026

Print or Download

[**Before you start your TFN declaration form**](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/tfn-declaration/before-you-start-your-tfn-declaration-form)

Understand the terms we use and work out if you should complete a TFN declaration form.

[**Access the TFN declaration form**](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/tfn-declaration/access-the-tfn-declaration-form)

Work out the type of TFN declaration form to use and how to access the forms.

[**Paper TFN declaration form for payees**](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/tfn-declaration/paper-tfn-declaration-form-for-payees)

How a payee can order and complete a paper TFN declaration form (NAT 3092).

[**Payer information and obligations**](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/tfn-declaration/payer-information-and-obligations)

What payers need to know about the Tax file number (TFN) declaration and their obligations.

[**View TFN declaration details online**](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/tfn-declaration/view-tfn-declaration-details-online)

How to view your current and historical TFN details in ATO online services.
